_comment: Профили на приложенията за AppPublisherBot (категория, данни, описателни ключове, цена). Хранят генераторите на meta/listing/forms/privacy. Цената по подразбиране е Paid 1.00 USD (потребителят иска пари) — сменя се на Free при нужда. ВНИМАНИЕ: всички апове имат 4-дневно пробно заключване (enforceLock) — виж trialLock бележката в формите.

aip1-guardian.pitchEn: Silent Guardian is a discreet personal-safety companion for moments when you may not be able to speak up. Jot down a calm note about your day — a secret word or phrase you choose, once it appears in that note, acts as a silent alarm that nobody around you notices. Pick a situation template (a general situation, an elderly person who has fallen or is unresponsive, domestic abuse, or a lone worker), add what you heard or what was said, and get a clear AI-assisted risk read — Observation, Attention, Alert or Critical — together with a ready, editable message you can send to your trusted contacts. A single silent button sends a quiet call for help with no sound and no visible change for the people around you, and a check-in timer raises an alert if you do not confirm you are safe in time. It works with built-in logic on your device; optionally you can add your own AI key (for example an Anthropic key) or a proxy endpoint, kept only locally, for a deeper AI-assisted read. IMPORTANT: this is a prototype safety companion — sending alerts is SIMULATED and this is NOT a real emergency service; if you are in real danger, call your local emergency number (112 in the EU). No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-guardian.newFeaturesEn: First release of Silent Guardian: discreet safety companion with a calm note, a hidden secret-word silent alarm, situation templates, an AI-assisted risk read (Observation/Attention/Alert/Critical), a ready message for trusted contacts, a one-tap silent help signal, a check-in timer and a 15-language interface. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for a deeper read; usable on-device without one. Prototype: alert sending is simulated, not a real emergency service.

dataHandling.notes: The app works on your device with built-in logic and has no accounts, ads or third-party tracking. Your note, trusted contacts and any optional home location are stored only locally on your device. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key (for example an Anthropic key) or a proxy endpoint; it is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you request an analysis, and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the context you chose to analyze is sent to the AI provider you selected to return the risk read; nothing else is transmitted, and without a key the app stays fully offline. IMPORTANT: this is a prototype — the sending of alerts to contacts is SIMULATED in the app and this is NOT a real emergency or dispatch service; in real danger, call your local emergency number (112 in the EU).

aip1-guardian.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. The inner app interface is in Bulgarian. Type a short note, choose a situation template and add context, then request the risk read — this works on-device with built-in logic and needs no key. To try the optional AI-assisted mode, open settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the context is sent to that provider only when you request an analysis. The silent help button and the alerts to trusted contacts are SIMULATED in this prototype — nothing is actually dispatched; it is not a real emergency service. All data is stored locally and can be cleared.

aip1-moodpatterns.pitchEn: Mood Patterns is a private mood and emotion journal that helps you understand how you really feel over time. Log your mood in seconds, add tags for what happened (sleep, work, people, weather, health), and see your mood charted day by day together with the patterns and tag correlations that shape it — which situations lift you up and which drag you down. Everything is stored locally on your device and nothing is ever sent anywhere without your own key and your explicit approval. Optionally add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept only on your device) to turn your entries into gentle AI-assisted weekly and monthly insights; without a key the app still works fully offline with its built-in summaries. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages. Mood Patterns is a self-reflection and journaling tool for general wellbeing — it is not medical or psychological advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it is not a substitute for a qualified professional.
aip1-moodpatterns.newFeaturesEn: First release of Mood Patterns: quick mood logging with tags, a mood-over-time chart, pattern and tag-correlation insights, local history you can export, and an optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for weekly and monthly AI insights, with a 15-language interface. Fully usable offline without a key; not medical or psychological advice.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline and keeps your mood journal only on your device. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press an AI-insight action, and only if you have configured such a key or endpoint, the entries you chose to analyze are sent to the AI provider you selected to return the insight; nothing else is transmitted, and there are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking. Mood Patterns is a self-reflection tool and is not medical or psychological advice.

aip1-moodpatterns.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Add an entry by choosing how you feel, optionally tag what happened and write a note, then Save; the mood chart, statistics and pattern/tag insights are computed on the device and work offline. To try the optional AI-assisted insights, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device), then press the weekly or monthly insight button; only then are the chosen entries sent to that provider. History is stored locally and can be exported or cleared. This is a journaling and self-reflection tool, not medical or psychological advice.

aip1-fairsplit.pitchEn: Fair Split is a fair-division assistant that settles who owes whom and who gets what. Split shared expenses and instantly see the smallest set of transfers that balances the group; divide inheritance or shared items fairly so everyone feels they got their fair share; and share out chores evenly. An optional, privacy-first AI helper can suggest fair value weightings and explain the result in plain words. It works fully offline: you can save and reload cases on the device, and no account or sign-in is ever required.
aip1-fairsplit.newFeaturesEn: First release of Fair Split: settle shared expenses with minimal transfers, fairly divide inheritance and shared items, share out chores, save and reload cases on-device, an optional user-supplied AI helper, and a 15-language interface.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline and needs no network for its core features. Optionally, you may enter YOUR OWN AI key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you explicitly trigger the AI helper is the text you entered sent to the AI provider CHOSEN BY YOU (for example your Anthropic key or your own proxy) to return a suggestion. Without an AI key the app runs entirely offline. We do not run our own server, collect personal data, or use advertising or tracking SDKs.

aip1-fairsplit.reviewerRemarksEn: No account, login, or internet connection is required. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Add a few people, then enter shared expenses (or switch mode to divide items or chores) and tap to compute the fair result; you can save and reload the case on-device. The AI helper is entirely OPTIONAL and off by default: it stays inactive unless you open Settings and enter your own AI key or proxy endpoint, and it then sends text only on your explicit action and only to the provider you chose. All core features work fully offline.

aip1-legacy.pitchEn: Legacy Keeper is a calm, private place to put your affairs in order — your last wishes, the people who matter, where your important assets and documents are, and the messages you want your loved ones to read one day. Instead of scattered notes, you keep everything in one clear, organized keepsake on your own device: heirs and who gets what, accounts and property, insurance and passwords hints, funeral preferences, and heartfelt letters. It works fully offline; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) and the app will help you draft, phrase and structure each section in your own words. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages. This is a personal organizer for your intentions — it is not a legally valid will; for legal force, consult a notary or lawyer.
aip1-legacy.newFeaturesEn: First release of Legacy Keeper: a private, offline organizer for your last wishes, heirs, assets, documents and messages to loved ones, with a clear multi-section layout and a printable summary. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint helps you draft and structure the text; fully usable offline without one. 15-language interface. Not a legally valid will.

dataHandling.notes: Everything you type — wishes, names, assets, documents, letters — is stored only locally on your device and is never sent anywhere by default; the app works fully offline. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press an AI Draft/Help action and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the text you chose for that section is sent to the AI provider you selected to return the drafted text; nothing else is transmitted, and there are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking. The app is a personal organizer of intentions and is not a legally valid will.

aip1-legacy.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. You will see sections for last wishes, heirs, assets, documents and messages to loved ones — type freely; everything is saved locally on the device. To try the optional AI-assisted drafting, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the text of the section you choose is sent to that provider only when you press an AI action. There is a clear on-screen notice that this is not a legally valid will. Data is stored locally and can be cleared.

aip1-manipulation.pitchEn: Manipulation Shield helps you spot when a message, ad, chat, email or contract is trying to manipulate you. Paste any text and it flags manipulation tactics — false urgency, artificial scarcity, fear and guilt tripping, flattery, fake authority, social pressure, too-good-to-be-true offers, scam and phishing patterns, hidden contract clauses and logical fallacies — with a clear risk level and per-tactic explanations, so you can decide with a cool head. It works fully offline with built-in heuristics; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) for a deeper AI-assisted analysis. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-manipulation.newFeaturesEn: First release of Manipulation Shield: paste-and-analyze manipulation detector with per-tactic risk scoring, local history, worked examples and 15-language interface. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for deeper analysis; fully usable offline without one.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline using built-in heuristics. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press Analyze and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the text you chose to analyze is sent to the AI provider you selected to return the analysis; nothing else is transmitted, and there are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking.

aip1-manipulation.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Paste or type any message into the text box (or tap an example) and press Analyze to see the manipulation-risk breakdown; this works offline with built-in heuristics. To try the optional AI-assisted mode, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the analyzed text is sent to that provider only when you press Analyze. History is stored locally and can be cleared.

aip1-reunite.pitchEn: Reunite is a lost-and-found network that helps missing pets, people, documents and belongings find their way home. Post what you lost or what you found — with a short description, category, place and date — and Reunite instantly compares it, on your device, against the other posts and surfaces the most likely matches with a similarity score, so a lost brown dog near the park meets the found brown dog by the lake. Browse and filter lost vs found by category, get an alert when a strong new match appears, and reach out to reunite. It works fully offline with built-in concept matching; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) for smarter, AI-assisted match explanations. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-reunite.newFeaturesEn: First release of Reunite: post lost or found pets, people, documents and items, get instant on-device similarity matching against nearby posts, browse and filter lost vs found by category, and get an alert when a strong new match appears. 15-language interface, local-only data. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for smarter match explanations; fully usable offline without one.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline using built-in on-device concept matching, and your posts stay only on your device. Optionally you may add YOUR OWN AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you explicitly request an AI-assisted match explanation and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the lost/found descriptions you chose are sent to the AI provider you selected to return the explanation; nothing else is transmitted. Without an AI key the app runs entirely offline. There are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking, and we do not run our own server.

aip1-reunite.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Fill in a lost or found post (type, category, title, description, place, date) and submit it to see the most likely matches with a similarity score against the sample posts; browse and filter lost vs found by category. This works fully offline with built-in on-device matching and demo data. To try the optional AI-assisted match explanation, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); text is sent to that provider only when you explicitly request an explanation. All posts are stored locally and can be cleared.

aip1-mediator.pitchEn: Fair Mediator helps two people settle a disagreement calmly and fairly. Describe the argument from both sides — what happened, what each person feels and wants — and it acts as a neutral, non-violent-communication mediator: a balanced summary that blames no one, the real needs behind each position, the common ground you already share, and concrete, respectful next steps and phrases you can actually say. Great for couples, family, friends, flatmates, co-workers and neighbours who want to de-escalate instead of win. It works fully offline with built-in mediation guidance; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) for a deeper, AI-assisted mediation. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-mediator.newFeaturesEn: First release of Fair Mediator: describe a conflict from both sides and get a neutral summary, each side's underlying needs, shared common ground and concrete non-violent next steps, plus ready-to-use calm phrasings. 15-language interface, local-only history. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for deeper mediation; fully usable offline without one.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline using built-in mediation guidance. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press the mediate/analyze button and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the conflict text you chose to submit is sent to the AI provider you selected to return the mediation; nothing else is transmitted, and there are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking.

aip1-mediator.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Type each side of the disagreement into the two text fields and press the mediate button to see a neutral summary, each side's needs, common ground and next steps; this works offline with built-in guidance. To try the optional AI-assisted mode, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the text is sent to that provider only when you press the mediate button. History is stored locally and can be cleared.

aip1-skillcoach.pitchEn: Skill Coach turns any skill into a hands-on, learn-by-doing plan. Tell it what you want to get better at — drawing, guitar, public speaking, cooking, coding or anything else — and it builds you a personalized 6-day micro-program of short daily practice tasks, each with a clear done-criterion so you always know when you have finished. It follows the science of deliberate practice: small, focused reps, honest self-rating after each task (too hard, just right, too easy) and steady progress you can see. It works fully offline with built-in expert programs for popular skills; optionally add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) and it will generate a tailored program for absolutely any skill you name. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-skillcoach.newFeaturesEn: First release of Skill Coach: pick any skill and get a personalized 6-day deliberate-practice micro-program with daily tasks, clear done-criteria, difficulty self-rating and on-device progress tracking. Built-in offline programs for popular skills; optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint generates a custom program for any skill. 15-language interface.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline using built-in practice programs. Optionally you may add YOUR OWN AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you ask the app to generate or coach a program, and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the skill name and your practice notes you chose to send are transmitted to the AI provider CHOSEN BY YOU to return the program; nothing else is transmitted. Without a key the app runs entirely offline. There are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking, and progress is stored only on the device.

aip1-skillcoach.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Choose one of the built-in skills (or type your own) and tap to build a 6-day program; each day shows a short task with a done-criterion you can mark complete and rate for difficulty. This works offline using built-in programs. To generate a custom program for any skill, open Settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the skill name and notes are sent to that provider only on your explicit action. Progress is stored locally and can be reset.

authenticator.pitchEn: A private two-factor authentication (2FA) app that generates TOTP/HOTP/Steam one-time codes and keeps all secrets in an encrypted, biometric-locked vault on your device. Add accounts by scanning a QR code, pasting an otpauth:// link, entering keys manually, or importing from Aegis and Google Authenticator, and export everything as QR images in a .zip.
authenticator.newFeaturesEn: First release: encrypted local 2FA vault with TOTP/HOTP/Steam codes, QR/manual/Aegis/Google Authenticator import, biometric unlock, and duplicate detection.

dataHandling.notes: All 2FA secrets are stored in an encrypted on-device vault; nothing is sent to any server. Camera is used only to scan otpauth QR codes. No login, no network.

authenticator.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required. On first launch pick a language and create a master password, which encrypts the local vault. Tap the + button and choose 'Scan QR code' (grant camera permission when asked) or 'Enter manually' to add a test account, then view the rotating 6-digit code on the list screen. All data stays on the device.

autoreply-bot.pitchEn: An automatic message-reply assistant that answers for you by your own rules: keyword triggers with ready replies, office hours, away messages, and allow/block lists. It logs every auto-reply and notifies you, and includes a built-in demo inbox so you can test everything instantly.
autoreply-bot.newFeaturesEn: First release: rule-based auto-replies with keywords, office hours, allow/block lists, a demo inbox, and local notifications for every answer sent.

dataHandling.notes: Rules and reply logs are stored on the device only. Network is used optionally to connect the Pupikes chat channel over HTTP. No account, no contacts, no tracking.

autoreply-bot.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is needed. On first launch choose a language, then tap 'Activate the robot — free' on the onboarding screen. Open the 'Demo' (inbox) tab and send a test message; the bot matches your rules and auto-replies, and the reply appears in the dashboard log. Nothing external is required to evaluate the app.

baby-monitor.pitchEn: A camera-based awareness assistant that watches your sleeping or playing child through the phone camera and alerts you on motion: it flags stirring/waking, a second person appearing in the room, or the child leaving the frame. Detection runs on-device with a local notification, sound, and a photo log for each event.
baby-monitor.newFeaturesEn: First release: on-device motion watching with child-aware alerts (stirring, stranger in room, left frame), local notifications, and an event log with snapshots.

dataHandling.notes: Video is processed on the device and never uploaded; event snapshots and logs stay local. Network is used only for a one-time free AI-model download and optionally a user-supplied camera/relay URL. In-app disclaimer states it is NOT a certified safety device.

baby-monitor.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch pick a language, read the onboarding (including the safety disclaimer that it is not a certified baby monitor), and continue to Permissions. Grant Camera (and optionally Notifications), point the phone camera at a scene, and start the watcher; moving in front of the camera triggers a local alert and a logged snapshot. Everything runs on-device.

business-faq-bot.pitchEn: A rule-based bot that automatically answers your customers' frequently asked questions using a keyword FAQ knowledge base, greetings, office-hours and out-of-hours messages, quick-reply buttons, and a fallback that escalates to a human. It runs entirely on-device with no paid AI, and a built-in demo chat lets you test it immediately.
business-faq-bot.newFeaturesEn: First release: on-device keyword FAQ knowledge base with office hours, quick-reply menus, human-escalation fallback, and a demo chat for instant testing.

dataHandling.notes: The FAQ knowledge base and settings are stored only on the device. Core answering works fully offline; network is used only for the optional Pupikes chat channel over HTTP. No accounts, no contacts, no tracking.

business-faq-bot.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is needed. On first launch choose a language and tap 'Activate the bot'. Keep the sample knowledge base, then open the Demo chat and type a question containing a keyword; the bot replies from the FAQ, respects office hours, and offers escalation. All evaluation can be done offline in the demo chat.

camera-watch.pitchEn: A camera-guard assistant that watches a camera feed and warns you on movement, telling you what moved: a person/intruder, dog, cat, or other animal. Motion is detected on-device with a local alert and a photo log for each event; it can use the phone camera or an external browser camera stream.
camera-watch.newFeaturesEn: First release: on-device motion detection with object recognition (person/animal), local alerts, a photo event log, and support for the phone camera or an external camera URL.

dataHandling.notes: Video is analyzed on the device and never leaves it; event snapshots and logs stay local. Network is used only for a one-time free AI-model download and optionally a user-supplied camera URL. No account, contacts, location, or tracking.

camera-watch.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch pick a language, read the onboarding, and tap 'Activate for free', then continue to Permissions and grant Camera (and optionally Notifications). Start the watcher and move in front of the camera; the app detects motion, labels what moved, fires a local notification, and adds a snapshot to the log. All processing happens on-device.

chat.pitchEn: A real-time messaging app that connects you to the Pupikes chat service. Pick from 15 languages and start chatting once you are online.
chat.newFeaturesEn: First release of Pupikes Chat: real-time messaging in 15 languages with a clean connect/offline experience.

dataHandling.notes: Connects to a live chat server; messages and account data are sent to and stored on the server, so data leaves the device. The app itself stores only the chosen UI language locally.

chat.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run choose a language and tap Start. It connects to the live chat server over the internet, so a working network connection is required. Account/registration steps happen inside the chat itself; no credentials are needed to reach the language screen and connect.

dodge-master.pitchEn: A top-down survival arcade game: you stand in the middle while projectiles fly in from every side and you move to dodge them across 10 levels of rising difficulty. Beat your best score and climb a local leaderboard.
dodge-master.newFeaturesEn: First release of EvadeArena: 10 levels of top-down projectile-dodging survival with a local top-100 leaderboard in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No network, no accounts. Only a self-entered nickname, score and language are stored on-device; nothing leaves the device.

dodge-master.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick a language and tap Start, then choose a level and press PLAY. Move your character to dodge incoming projectiles until the level ends. No account, login, or internet connection is required; an optional name for the local leaderboard is the only input.

duel.pitchEn: A 1-vs-1 turn-based fighting game where your randomly assigned hero battles across 10 levels. Land basic hits and discover each hero hidden 4-key special combo to unleash powerful attacks.
duel.newFeaturesEn: First release of Ring Duel: 1-vs-1 turn-based combat over 10 levels with hidden special-move combos and a local leaderboard in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline standalone game. No accounts, no network. Only a self-entered nickname, score and language are stored on-device.

duel.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run choose a language and tap Start, then press Start/Begin in the menu. Fight turn by turn: pick a basic attack, or try key combinations to discover the hero's hidden special move. No account, login, or internet is required; it runs entirely offline and only asks for an optional leaderboard name.

fps-hunter.pitchEn: A 3D first-person hunting shooter with 100 levels, a range of weapons, and animal and other targets. Use the on-screen joystick and fire button to move, aim, and shoot your way up a local leaderboard.
fps-hunter.newFeaturesEn: First release of Huntline 3D: a 3D first-person hunting shooter with 100 levels, multiple weapons, touch controls, and a local top-10 leaderboard in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only a self-entered nickname, score and language are stored on-device.

fps-hunter.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick a language and tap Start, then choose a starting level and press START. On phone use the left joystick to move, drag on the right side to aim, and tap the FIRE button to shoot the targets. No account, login, or internet connection is needed; an optional name for the local top-10 is the only input.

hmm.pitchEn: A 3-vs-3 turn-based team battle where your randomly assigned heroes fight across 10 levels. Land basic hits and discover each hero hidden 4-key special combo to turn the fight.
hmm.newFeaturesEn: First release of Battlefield HMM: 3-vs-3 turn-based team battles over 10 levels with hidden special-move combos and a local leaderboard in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline standalone game. No accounts, no network. Only a self-entered nickname, score and language are stored on-device.

hmm.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run choose a language, then start the battle from the menu (Start / Space). Command your 3 heroes turn by turn: pick basic attacks or try key combinations to unlock each hero's hidden special. No account, login, or internet is required; it runs entirely offline and only asks for an optional leaderboard name.

monitor-bot.pitchEn: An on-device watcher for any RSS/Atom feed or public JSON API you choose: it sends a local notification when a new entry appears or a keyword matches. Everything runs on the device with unlimited monitors, scheduled checks and change-diffing.
monitor-bot.newFeaturesEn: First release: create unlimited feed and JSON monitors with keyword matching and on-schedule local alerts, all running entirely on your device.

dataHandling.notes: Fetches only the RSS/Atom or JSON sources the user enters (optionally via a user-supplied CORS proxy). Monitors, logs and settings are stored locally; no account, no cloud, no analytics. Local notifications only.

monitor-bot.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch pick a language, tap through the onboarding, then grant the notification permission and add a monitor by pasting a public RSS/Atom feed URL or a JSON API URL. Use 'Check now' to fetch immediately; a match is written to the log and shown as a local notification. Internet is used only to download the source you entered.

plane-shooter.pitchEn: A fast arcade shoot-em-up where you pilot a plane, shoot down waves of enemies and survive 10 increasingly difficult levels. Fully offline single-player action.
plane-shooter.newFeaturesEn: First release: 10 levels of arcade plane-shooting action with escalating difficulty and power-ups, playable fully offline.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No network, no hardware permissions, no accounts. Only local game settings/progress are kept on the device.

plane-shooter.reviewerRemarksEn: No account, login or internet connection is needed. Launch the app, pick a language on first run, and tap Start to play. Control the plane to shoot enemies and progress through the 10 levels. Everything runs offline on the device. This app is FREE and contains cross-promotion ads for our own other apps (house ads) shown at start, mid-session and game over; each ad is closeable.

price-watch-bot.pitchEn: A price watcher that tracks selected crypto (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE) and currency rates and sends a local notification the moment a price crosses a threshold you set. It only reads prices from free public sources and never handles payments or wallets.
price-watch-bot.newFeaturesEn: First release: set high/low price thresholds on crypto and currency rates and get on-device local alerts, with checks every 15 minutes, hourly or daily.

dataHandling.notes: Reads read-only public price data from public exchange APIs. No wallet, no trading, no payments, no personal data. Watch list, thresholds and logs are stored locally; local notifications only.

price-watch-bot.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch choose a language and activate the robot, then grant notifications and add a watch by picking a crypto or currency, a threshold and a direction. Internet is only used to read public exchange rates. Use 'Check now' to test; when a threshold is crossed a local notification is shown. The app only monitors prices; it does not buy, sell or hold assets.

routine-bot.pitchEn: A personal daily assistant that runs a morning briefing (weather, agenda and motivation), fires reminders for medication, habits and tasks, and gives an optional evening summary. It can also read your notes aloud in any of 15 languages.
routine-bot.newFeaturesEn: First release: daily morning briefing with weather, scheduled reminders for tasks and habits, an optional evening summary, and notes read aloud via on-device text-to-speech.

dataHandling.notes: Network is used only to fetch weather from a public service by a city NAME the user types (no GPS/device location). Text-to-speech uses the device speaker. Reminders, notes and settings are stored locally; local notifications only, no account, no cloud.

routine-bot.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or login is required. On first launch pick a language and activate the robot, then grant the notification permission. Add reminders (with time and days), notes, and optionally type a city name to enable the weather part of the morning briefing. Use the briefing preview to see it immediately. Internet is used only for weather lookups by city name; location/GPS is never accessed.

rustam.pitchEn: A casual arcade game where you help a gardener pick all the cucumbers before the moles get them across 10 levels. A light, offline single-player challenge with a growing timer-hole mechanic.
rustam.newFeaturesEn: First release: 10 levels of cucumber-picking arcade fun with racing moles and a shrinking-hole timer, playable fully offline.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No network, no hardware permissions, no accounts. Only local game settings/progress are kept on the device.

rustam.reviewerRemarksEn: No account, login or internet connection is needed. Launch the app, choose a language on first run, and tap Start to play. Collect the cucumbers before the moles reach them and advance through the 10 levels. Everything runs offline on the device.

selflearning-friend.pitchEn: A private AI companion that you name and teach yourself: it talks with you by voice or text, learns knowledge from the web, and can see through the camera. Everything it learns and remembers stays on your own device, tied to a secret code word only you know.
selflearning-friend.newFeaturesEn: First release: name and raise your own private AI friend that learns from you by voice, gathers knowledge, and keeps all memory on your device behind a secret code word.

dataHandling.notes: No developer account or sign-in; access is guarded by a user-chosen local code word. Personal data (name, habits, memory) is stored only on the device and not uploaded by default. Microphone is used for voice conversation and camera for the optional Vision feature. Network fetches general knowledge and translations and can optionally sync with a user-supplied server; there is no developer backend collecting data.

selflearning-friend.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or registration is needed. On first launch pick a UI language, then on the 'birth' screen choose a one-word secret code (remember it — there is no hint) and give the friend a name; the app opens to Chat. To review, type in Chat or grant microphone permission to talk by voice; the Vision tab requests camera. All data stays on the device and the optional server link can be left empty.

services-toolkit.pitchEn: An all-in-one utility box with QR codes, password and text tools, calculators, image and PDF compression, currency rates and crypto charts, a web scraper and a free AI text helper. Most tools run entirely on the device, with a few that fetch live online data.
services-toolkit.newFeaturesEn: First release: a single app bundling QR codes, password generator, calculators, text/image/PDF tools, live currency and crypto charts, web scraper and an AI text generator, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: No account or login. Offline tools (QR, passwords, calculators, text, image/PDF compression) run fully on-device. Camera is used only when scanning a QR code. Network is used by the online tools (currency rates, crypto charts, web scraper, AI text). No personal data is collected or uploaded.

services-toolkit.reviewerRemarksEn: No account needed. On first launch choose a language and tap Start to reach the tool grid, then open any tool. Offline tools work with no connection; online tools (currency, crypto, scraper, AI text) need internet. The QR tool asks for camera permission only when you start scanning, and the currency watcher may request notification permission for alerts.

titans-fight.pitchEn: A single-player arcade fighting game across 10 levels: pick your weapon, beat each foe to unlock the next and climb from Rookie to God of War. Scores are saved to a local leaderboard on your device.
titans-fight.newFeaturesEn: First release: a 10-level one-on-one fighting game with unlockable weapons, combos and a local high-score leaderboard, playable fully offline in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No account, no network calls, no device permissions. Level progress and the leaderboard (an optional player name plus scores) are stored only in local storage on the device.

titans-fight.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or internet is required. On first launch pick a language, then tap a level in the menu to start; choose a weapon and press Fight. Win a match to unlock the next level, and optionally enter a name to save a score to the on-device leaderboard. The app requests no runtime permissions.

houselookbook.pitchEn: Design and arrange your dream home floor by floor: choose the footprint, roof style, number of floors, wall and accent colors, add rooms and upload photos, then browse a gallery of other people’s homes and climb a community ranking of the most-liked designs.
houselookbook.newFeaturesEn: First release: floor-by-floor home designer, photo uploads, a public gallery and a most-liked ranking, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Connects to a live server (houselook.pupikes.com). Account/registration details and the designs and photos you upload are sent to and stored on the server, so this data leaves the device. A subscription for premium features is handled through the store billing.

houselookbook.reviewerRemarksEn: The app is a thin wrapper that loads the live web app at https://houselook.pupikes.com over the internet (a working network connection is required). On first run you can browse; creating and saving a home design requires a free account created inside the app. No credentials are needed to open the app and view the gallery.

gl1-gravity.pitchEn: Gravity Leap is a physics slingshot game: hop from planet to planet by riding each world's gravity. Time your thrust to swing off along the tangent and reach the next planet across 16 hand-tuned levels with orbiting moons, asteroid belts, black holes and a gravity slingshot. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-gravity.newFeaturesEn: First release of Gravity Leap: a canvas-2D gravity slingshot game with 16 procedural levels, orbiting moons, asteroid belts and black holes, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-gravity.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, hold the left/right buttons to rotate your craft and press GAS to thrust; use each planet's gravity to slingshot toward the next planet and clear the level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-flock.pitchEn: Flock Drift is a gentle steering game: guide your migrating flock of birds through drifting wind, dunes and night skies while keeping the formation together. Lead the V-formation, ride tailwinds, dodge predators and rocks and gather stragglers before they fall behind, across a series of hand-tuned migration levels. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-flock.newFeaturesEn: First release of Flock Drift: a canvas-2D flock-steering game where you lead a migrating flock through wind, dunes, night skies, predators and obstacles across hand-tuned levels, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-flock.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, use the on-screen direction pads to steer your flock: lead the birds toward the destination, keep the formation together, and avoid predators and obstacles to clear each level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-shadow.pitchEn: Shadowbound is a runner with a twist: you lead only the shadow of a man walking a clear road above. Every obstacle lives in the shadow's plane — jump the rocks and pits, duck under the beams. When the shadow stumbles, the real man above staggers, bleeds and can die. Guide the shadow through 18 hand-tuned levels with pits, double sections, moving obstacles and flickering light. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-shadow.newFeaturesEn: First release of Shadowbound: a canvas-2D shadow-runner across 18 levels with pits, combo sections, moving obstacles and flickering light, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-shadow.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, tap JUMP to leap over rocks and pits and hold DUCK to pass under beams — you control only the shadow; the man above is hurt when the shadow fails an obstacle. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-rewind.pitchEn: Rewind The Cause is a side-scrolling game where time runs backwards. You walk back through a collapsing street, un-fire your shot so the bullet returns to the barrel, and every fallen figure you reach stands up alive again. Each revival stitches the rift in time shut. Race back to the very first second across 15 hand-tuned levels with rewinding rubble, rolling wreckage, reversing cars and backward blasts. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-rewind.newFeaturesEn: First release of Rewind The Cause: a canvas-2D reverse-time game with 15 levels, un-firing shots that revive the fallen, backward hazards and one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-rewind.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, hold the on-screen buttons to walk back, jump and fire in reverse; every shot un-fires and the fallen figures you reach revive, closing the time rift. Reach the start of the street to clear the level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-seasons.pitchEn: Seasongate is a side-scrolling quest where you switch the four seasons to reshape the world. A warrior marches across a wild land to a distant tower to free a captured princess. Every gate is blocked by something one season opens and another seals: freeze a river to ice in winter, douse a wildfire with the spring downpour, bake the mud solid in summer, wither the thorns in autumn. Fight off beasts — wolf packs, snakes, hornet swarms and crows — where only the right season drives them away, dodge avalanches, floods and spreading fire, free prisoners from cages and watchtowers, and win a weapon reward on the way. Switch the season at the right moment across 18 hand-tuned levels — the number of switches is limited. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-seasons.newFeaturesEn: First release of Seasongate: a canvas-2D four-season side-scroller with 18 hand-tuned levels, season-switching puzzles, beasts and hazards, rescued prisoners and a weapon reward, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-seasons.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, hold the on-screen buttons to march forward and jump, and press the season button to switch between winter, spring, summer and autumn (the number of switches is limited). Change the season to open each blocked gate and to drive off the beasts, avoid avalanches, floods and fire, and reach the tower to clear the level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-candle.pitchEn: Eternal Flame is a reflex game about keeping a single candle burning in the dark. Threats close in from every side, each announced on the rim before it strikes: wind, whirlwinds and thieving torches from the left and right, water, rain and downpours from above, swords, stones and arrows head-on. Meet each one with the right guard for the right direction — raise the giant hand to the side, cover the flame with your palm from above, or lift the shield up front — and hold the guard through storms. Survive across 12 hand-tuned nights with wider windows, longer holds and a short all-blocking dome you earn along the way. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-candle.newFeaturesEn: First release of Eternal Flame: a canvas-2D flame-guarding reflex game across 12 nights with side, overhead and frontal threats, hold-to-parry storms, earned abilities and a short protective dome, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-candle.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game a candle burns in the center and threats approach from the sides, above and the front, each marked on the rim. Raise the giant hand (left/right) against wind from a side, cover with the palm (up) against water from above, and lift the shield up front against blades and stones — hold the guard for storms. Defend the flame until each night's goal is met. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-queue.pitchEn: The Climb is a one-tap timing game set on an endless staircase rising through the clouds. Tap the bottom of the screen to climb one step forward; tap the top to overtake, a riskier move whose reward keeps growing. Catch up to the figure ahead and you push on together. Keep your rhythm to clear all 15 hand-tuned levels of drifting fog, marble steps and crumbling cracks and reach the loop at the top. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-queue.newFeaturesEn: First release of The Climb: a canvas-2D one-tap timing game with 15 levels on an endless cloud staircase, tap-bottom to climb and tap-top to overtake for a growing risky reward, crumbling steps and drifting fog, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-queue.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, tap the lower half of the screen to climb one step forward and tap the upper half to overtake for a growing but riskier reward; keep your rhythm and clear all 15 levels to reach the loop at the top. Falling too far behind ends the run. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-soundonly.pitchEn: Echo Duel is a hunt in total darkness where the enemy gives itself away only by sound: a pulse of waves that quickly fades. Click the centre of the sound to strike — the more precise the click, the harder the hit — then dodge left or right to slip the counter-attack, and manage your distance on the vertical axis. Fight through 100 levels across 10 upgrade decades, each granting you a new tool while the enemy gains a new power. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-soundonly.newFeaturesEn: First release of Echo Duel: a canvas-2D + WebAudio audio-hunting game with 100 levels across 10 upgrade decades, precise click-to-strike, dodge-the-counter combat and distance management, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device. Game sound is generated on-device with WebAudio; the microphone is never used.

gl1-soundonly.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Turn the device sound on: each enemy reveals its position only with a fading sound pulse. Tap/click the centre of the sound to strike, press the left/right buttons right after to dodge the counter, and use up/down to change distance. Defeat the enemies to advance through the levels. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-underworlds.pitchEn: Core Descent is a mining puzzle: dig your way straight down to the glowing core of the Earth. Every level is a hand-built shaft of soil, rock, ore, crystal, magma and caves. Pick the right tool for each obstacle — pickaxe and shovel for stone, a drill for solid walls, a heat suit for lava, a detonator for gunpowder, a pump for flooded tunnels, a rope for chasms and a lamp for the dark — and clear a safe path to the bottom. Every level is solvable. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-underworlds.newFeaturesEn: First release of Core Descent: a canvas-2D underground mining puzzle across hand-tuned levels with layered soil, rock, ore, crystal and magma, tool-based obstacles (pickaxe, shovel, drill, heat suit, detonator, pump, rope, lamp) and environmental hazards, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-underworlds.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, use the left/right buttons to move, up to climb or act, and the action button to use the highlighted tool; dig downward and pick the right tool for each obstacle (pickaxe and shovel for stone, drill for walls, heat suit for lava, detonator for gunpowder, pump for flooded tunnels, rope for chasms, lamp for the dark) to reach the glowing core at the bottom. Every level is solvable. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

gl1-bloodstream.pitchEn: Bloodstream Command is a real-time strategy game set inside a living body. You command the defensive cells: drag to select them, then tap an infection focus and they stream along the veins to destroy it. The beating heart shifts the tempo, toxic veins and clots slow your cells, and armored, healing and mutant foci fight back. Keep the body's integrity above zero and clear every focus across 16 hand-tuned levels. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
gl1-bloodstream.newFeaturesEn: First release of Bloodstream Command: a canvas-2D real-time strategy game with 16 procedural levels, drag-to-select defensive cells, armored/healing/mutant infection foci, toxic veins, clots and boost/heal abilities, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

gl1-bloodstream.reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, drag on the screen to select your defensive cells (or tap the central heart to select all), then tap an infection focus and the selected cells travel along the veins to attack it. Use the on-screen Boost and Heal buttons when unlocked. Destroy all foci before the body's integrity reaches zero to clear the level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.

aip1-symptombridge.pitchEn: Symptom Bridge helps you turn what you feel into a clear, well-ordered summary to hand your doctor, so nothing important gets forgotten in a short appointment. Answer a few guided questions or type freely, and the app organises your complaint into structured sections a clinician expects — main complaint, onset and course, location, intensity, character, what makes it better or worse, associated symptoms, current medications and allergies. Keep separate profiles for family members, save each visit to a local history, and copy or print the summary to show or read out to the doctor. It works fully offline; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) to have free-text tidied and phrased more clearly. It is NOT a medical device and does NOT diagnose or give medical advice — it only helps you communicate with your doctor. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-symptombridge.newFeaturesEn: First release of Symptom Bridge: a guided and free-text symptom organiser that builds a doctor-ready structured summary, with per-family-member profiles, local visit history, copy/print, and a 15-language interface. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint to refine free text; fully usable offline without one. Not a medical device; does not diagnose.

dataHandling.notes: Your health information (complaints, profiles and visit history) is stored only locally on your device and is never sent to us; we have no accounts, no ads and no third-party tracking. The app works fully offline. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press the AI action, and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the symptom text you chose is sent to the AI provider you selected in order to tidy the wording; without a key the app works offline. Symptom Bridge is NOT a medical device and does NOT diagnose or provide medical advice — it only helps organise your communication with your doctor.

aip1-symptombridge.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Answer the guided questions or type your complaint freely, then press Build to get a structured, doctor-ready summary; this works fully offline. You can keep several profiles (e.g. family members), save a visit to the local history, and copy or print the summary. The optional AI mode is off by default: open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the symptom text is sent to that provider only when you press the AI action. The app does not diagnose and is not a medical device.

aip1-plainaction.pitchEn: Plain Action turns any confusing document into a plain-language summary and a clear checklist of what you actually need to do. Paste a message, email, contract, official letter, bill, terms of service or notice and it explains it in simple words, then lists concrete action items with any deadlines, flags what to watch out for, and can draft a reply or response for you. It works fully offline with built-in logic; optionally you can add your own AI key or proxy endpoint (kept locally on your device) for deeper, AI-assisted summaries and drafts. No account, no tracking, in 15 languages.
aip1-plainaction.newFeaturesEn: First release of Plain Action: paste-and-simplify tool that turns any document into a plain-language summary plus an actionable checklist with deadlines, warnings and drafted replies, with local history and a 15-language interface. Optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for deeper analysis; fully usable offline without one.

dataHandling.notes: The app works fully offline using built-in logic. Optionally you may add your own AI provider key or proxy endpoint, which is stored only locally on your device and is never embedded in the app. Only when you press the analyze/simplify action and only if you have configured such a key/endpoint, the document text you chose to process is sent to the AI provider you selected to return the summary and checklist; nothing else is transmitted, and there are no accounts, ads or third-party tracking.

aip1-plainaction.reviewerRemarksEn: No account or sign-in is required and internet is optional. On first launch pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Paste or type any document into the text box (or tap an example) and press the analyze/simplify action to see a plain-language summary and a checklist of what to do; this works offline with built-in logic. To try the optional AI-assisted mode, open the gear/settings and enter your own AI proxy endpoint or Anthropic API key (stored only on the device); the document text is sent to that provider only when you run the action. History is stored locally and can be cleared.
